query:
SELECT m.id, m.timeSlot, m.attendeeId, s.companyName as sponsor,
  dp.firstName, dp.lastName
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
LEFT JOIN delegateProfiles dp ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId
WHERE 
  -- PerchPeek: Adam Binks (slot 1) and Jonathan Kitterhing (slot 5)
  (s.companyName LIKE '%PerchPeek%' AND m.timeSlot IN (1,5))
  -- Stepstone: Adam Binks (slot 2), Jessica Shaunie Green (slot 6), Joanna Hackett (slot 4), Carly George (slot 1)
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Stepstone%' AND m.timeSlot IN (1,2,4,6))
  -- Wilson: Tush Wijeratne (slot 1), James Harley (slot 10), Mark Kunaseelan (slot 7), Anna Katyal (slot 11), Michelle Monahan (slot 8), Alan MacKinnon (slot 2)
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Wilson%' AND m.timeSlot IN (1,2,7,8,10,11))
  -- Radancy: Joanna Hackett (slot 3), Salina Budaly (slot 5)
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Radancy%' AND m.timeSlot IN (3,5))
  -- Poetry: Lucy Bousfield (slot 10), Sarah Cooper (slot 2)
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Poetry%' AND m.timeSlot IN (2,10))
  -- Udder: Jules Anderson (slot 11), Robyn Collins (slot 3)
  OR (s.companyName LIKE '%Udder%' AND m.timeSlot IN (3,11))
ORDER BY s.companyName, m.timeSlot;
